name: agentic-workflow-doctor
description: User-initiated batch ceremony-failure triage: mine this project's own journal and unit docs for its accumulated ceremony failures, apply a fixed discard/report rubric, render one anonymized bundle, and route it upstream to an existing or new agentic-workflow issue — with consent. Read-only; the user starts it. Triggers: "agentic-workflow-doctor", "aw-doctor", "why do my reviews keep blocking", "triage my ceremony failures", "report a workflow bug upstream".
